mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases equity discount rates and reduces corporate borrowing capacity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 5.0% is followed by positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS over 20-day horizons remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating condition (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals tight labor supply that fuels wage inflation and forces aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0% is followed by positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for UNRATE in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic momentum, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS rising is followed by negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a supply shock that increases recession risk and reduces corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 6.0 periods, INDPRO below 100 is followed by positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 5.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts immediate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 5.0% is followed by positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL over 5-day horizons is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates manufacturing sector weakness that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100 is followed by positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO over 60-day horizons is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary economic regime (GDPC1 year-over-year growth rate < 0.5%), a month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals recovery initiation that boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In GDPC1 YoY growth < 0.5% periods, HOUST rising is followed by negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for HOUST in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average is followed by negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS over 5-day horizons is below 0.03.
